incidents.latestUpdate: github.com and the GitHub API are returning errors for the majority of requests. Git operations over both HTTPS & SSH are failing. We are all hands on deck.

incidents.latestUpdate:
We are continuing to investigate elevated queue times for Actions workflow runs. Hosted runners are being provisioned, but jobs may wait several minutes before starting.

Self-hosted runners are unaffected.

incidents.name: Incident with Git Operations and Actions
incidents.latestUpdate:
We have identified a degradation in a shared storage tier affecting git pushes and Actions job orchestration. Pushes to some repositories are failing with a 500, and queued workflow runs are not starting.

Mitigation is in progress. Retrying a failed push is safe.
